project.name: ruby-saml
project.mechanism: SAML authentication bypass through XML parser differentials

scope_decision.target_meaning: The target is the shared parser-differential detection locus, not the complete seven-file patch.
scope_decision.compound_target: One semantically adjudicated parser-differential target covers the shared root cause. The result must not be reported as two independent CVE recoveries.
scope_decision.downstream_context: Changes in lib/onelogin/ruby-saml/response.rb bind application use to cached, signature-referenced XML and are relevant human falsification context.

pre_fix.confirmed_recovery: Requires human semantic adjudication target_match plus falsification status confirmed for the shared parser-differential mechanism.
pre_fix.location_only: Pending human adjudication; not a target match.

post_fix.location_only: Pending human adjudication; not automatic persistence.

acceptance.non_target_findings: Remain unadjudicated because the project answer key is not exhaustive.
acceptance.production_planner: Forced target inclusion receives no production coverage credit. Target omission is planner coverage evidence, not a semantic model false negative.
acceptance.prohibited_claim: Do not report separate recovery counts for CVE-2025-25291 and CVE-2025-25292 from this compound target.

prohibited_changes_after_run: batch, call, token, or timeout limits
